headline: Bitcoin Falls 1.78 Percent To 79k
narrative: Bitcoin fell 1.78 percent to 79k. The 9:38 p.m. Eastern print was 80k and the 11:56 p.m. print was 79k. Exchanges recorded a $471 million net outflow over 24 hours, meaning more dollar value left trading venues than entered, a mild accumulation read.
author: jordan
